XamlAnimatedPng UWP integration for LumINE

Upstream: https://github.com/xupefei/XamlAnimatedPng
Commit: 227e62d72bad3b689f9c7250f2f1c47250c36461
Upstream fork origin: https://github.com/XamlAnimatedGif/XamlAnimatedGif
License: Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE.txt in this directory.

TimingManager.cs is vendored from XamlAnimatedGif.Shared/TimingManager.cs.
Modifications: select the WINRT branch for UWP; clamp the final frame wait to
the requested animation duration.

ApngAnimator.Uwp.cs is a LumINE integration adapter based on the upstream
Animator.RunAsync scheduling and WINRT CopyToBitmap buffer-copy rendering.
The upstream repository labels APNG support as WIP and the pinned source
still uses GifDataStream/LZW. LumINE therefore supplies its existing APNG
decoder, compositor and bounded prepared-frame cache to this adapter.

This integration does not claim that unmodified upstream can decode APNG.
